title: UAP secrecy justified under a law enforcement provision

tellings.quote: he noticed that they are justifying secrecy under a law enforcement provision rather than just National Security

plain: The US government has been keeping records on UAP, its official term for UFOs, secret by citing a law enforcement provision rather than the usual national security grounds. Michael Shellenberger, a journalist, says this was noticed by John Greenewald Jr., a researcher who requests government records. Shellenberger tells it in an episode about Immaculate Constellation, a secret UFO program he reported on, as a sign that the secrecy is unusual.
